Repair the ramble-to-done protocol, validator, schema, resume, next-batch, source coverage, and blocker reporting behavior.
Refresh the master backlog reconciliation before implementation and collapse source statements into canonical executable requirements.
Clean up production Tasks and Decisions so default views are scoped, relevant, deduped, and reversible.
Implement One Time workspace users, roles, role updates, audit logs, relationship enforcement, and negative authorization tests.
Audit every visible action and ensure visible controls work, are disabled with exact blockers, or are intentionally informational.
Correct Operations UI navigation, horizontal filter rails, sticky toolbar, mobile toolbar, buttons, cards, and responsive behavior.
Complete WhatsApp UX using the existing first-party WAPI/Whapi system without sending WhatsApp messages.
Complete Email and Resend UX without live sends, including domain/status readback, webhook code, and one sender/domain Decision.
Complete product, scheduling, booking, parent portal, student portal, provider portal, and billing/access foundations without live charges.
Implement manual Vimeo library workflow now and automated Vimeo upload readiness behind disabled feature flag.
Implement Zoom API client, session workflow, webhooks, and attendance foundation without creating a real class meeting.
Implement transcript privacy with review states, matching confidence, visibility classes, and no cross-child exposure.
Implement server-side event-driven gamification badges with thresholds, idempotency, reversal, audit, and no public individual leaderboard.
Complete community moderation, private questions, parent-visible communication, edit/archive history, reporting, and private-to-public anonymization.
Prepare approved Sefaria source model and disabled study-assistant readiness with scoped retrieval and citation guardrails.
Prepare Option B separate One Time deployment readiness without provisioning paid infrastructure or DNS.
Run final verification, push PR #5 branch, deploy safe bundle, smoke production, and leave only genuine external actions.
Register the Telegram plus website-assistant addendum under the existing issue #7 parent source without creating duplicate systems.
Define the shared assistant control-plane contract for Telegram, website assistant, Operations helper, provider portal, parent portal, student portal where enabled, and future approved channels.

Add the shared assistant data model for channels, identities, conversations, messages, context objects, action plans/runs, previews, approvals, drafts/versions, templates, saved views, reminders, notifications, onboarding sessions, delivery outbox, and dead letters.
Make the action registry the single parity source for UI buttons, Telegram requests, website assistant requests, Operations helper requests, automation actions, and Agent Work handoffs.
Implement one registry-constrained natural-language planner and runner shared by Telegram and website assistant adapters.
Create the shared preview, draft, template, versioning, compare, active-version, rollback, and approval model.
Unify file/media/forwarded-message intake for Telegram and website uploads.
Replace separate service-provider onboarding form/forum behavior with assistant-led onboarding backed by Service Provider Studio.
Add parent natural-language self-service for linked-child chart/dashboard layouts, allowed updates, reminders, questions, support tickets, and communication preferences.
Add the canonical natural-language chart and dashboard configuration model.
Add super-admin natural-language control for campaigns, drip sequences, segments, versioning, previews, approval, scheduling, monitoring, failures, and Agent Work.

Add natural-language automation builder with typed triggers, conditions, delays, branches, template versions, dry run, readable/diagram preview, versioning, enable/disable, audit, retries, and approval gates.
Implement natural-language ticketing/problem resolution across Telegram and website assistant.
Unify reminders and proactive notifications across Telegram, in-app, email, SMS/WhatsApp where configured.
Scope the control plane across BNA/family, One Time, service providers, providers, parents, students where enabled, and super-admin contexts without workspace leakage.

Add Operations Assistant Control Center for conversations, actor/role/workspace, planned actions, previews, approvals, automations, campaigns, reminders, Agent Work, tickets, deliveries, failures, and audit history.
Complete cross-channel QA, release gates, documentation, live synthetic journeys, deployment/live-smoke evidence, and final ChatGPT return packet sections for Telegram and website parity.
Create a clean integration branch from current origin/master and integrate PR #12, PR #13, and the final pushed SHA from the currently running agent into one owner-review candidate.
Run clean install, full test suite, secret audit, security watchdogs, route watchdogs, independent clean-worktree verification, and add CI/status checks if missing.

Automatically inventory every public HTML page, server UI route, API route, alias, redirect, literal and JavaScript-generated link, form action, window.location destination, manifest entry, service-worker route, login/logout destination, and assistant/API deep link.
Produce the canonical route matrix and fix broken links, dead ends, auth loops, unexplained orphan pages, duplicate canonical destinations, missing return paths, and inconsistent shared navigation.
Canonicalize the One Time journey across /one-time, /rabbi, /rabbi-member, /member-library, /member, and /one-time-classroom.
Repair the public, provider, parent, student, provider-participant, One Time, and Operations information architecture and navigation.
Make website assistant parity visible and correctly scoped on actual user surfaces, not only in action contracts or Operations UI hooks.

Run credential-free desktop/mobile browser journeys for anonymous public visitor, parents, student, provider admin, provider participant/member, One Time member, super-admin, wrong-role, and logged-out access using synthetic local fixtures and mock integrations.
Rerun and reconcile the existing UX/click-map backlog, classifying prior issues as resolved, still reproducible, superseded, false positive, intentionally deferred, or external-credential blocked.

Add permanent release tests for complete page discovery, dead links, orphan pages, missing route implementations, duplicate canonical pages, form destinations, auth recovery paths, return paths, mobile navigation, route registry drift, and visible controls without handlers.

Produce the owner-review packet: applied/not-applied matrix, canonical sitemap, route inventory, navigation graph, orphan/duplicate report, role-flow QA, UX backlog reconciliation, screenshots, review script, release SHA, and final blocker list.
